summary: Implemented unknown-total (None) support for Progress tasks in rich/progress.py, rich/progress_bar.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and tests/test_progress.py. Added TaskProgressColumn (exported from rich.progress), made Task/ProgressBar/columns handle total=None (pulse, blank percentage/ETA/size, "?" counts, "x/? unit" downloads), and guarded finish detection. Tests: tests/test_progress.py and tests/test_bar.py pass (53 tests, including 10 new). Full suite without tests/test_pretty.py: 13 failures in card, markdown, syntax, and traceback tests, identical to the unmodified baseline. tests/test_pretty.py cannot be collected because the venv lacks 'attr'. Black is not installed in the venv, so formatting was done by hand and not verified with black. Nothing committed.
